settings.heading: Raising the Bar on Your Child's Nutrition

settings.title: Fights Hidden Hunger
settings.body: 80% of children don't eat enough fruits and veggies, contributing to a nutrient deficiency known as hidden hunger. Our gummies fight hidden hunger with essential nutrients critical to development.

settings.title: Developed Alongside Harvard & Yale Scientists
settings.body: Our product was crafted with input from leading scientists at Harvard and Yale, combining the latest research with high-quality ingredients to deliver a multivitamin parents can trust.

settings.title: Backed by Modern Science
settings.body: Vitamin B6 supports natural energy regulation, promoting healthier sleep patterns and making it easier for kids to get restful sleep.*

settings.title: Pediatrician-Approved
settings.body: Recommended by pediatricians, our multivitamin is designed to meet the unique needs of your family ensuring they get the support they need from a trusted source.

settings.title: Clean Label Project® Purity Award
settings.body: Our products were independently tested by Clean Label Project® for harmful chemicals like heavy metals, pesticides, and plasticizers, exceeding typical industry practices.

settings.title: Ingredients Sourcing and Dosage
settings.body: We source each ingredient with care, choosing only the highest quality vitamins and minerals. Our dosage is tailored for teens, providing safe and effective support without risking overuse or unwanted additives.
